metadata.what: CineStill 50D: Kodak Vision3 50D (5203/7203) with its rem-jet anti-halation backing removed, sold for still cameras in 135 and 120.
metadata.data: None of its own. The engine loads kodak_vision3_50d whole and overrides only the info keys below (load_profile, derived_from), so no array of the CC BY-SA profile is copied or derived here. Same construction as upstream's cinestill_800t.
metadata.physics: The one physical difference is the missing rem-jet: light scattered into the base reflects off its back face and re-exposes the emulsion from behind. antihalation 'no' selects that halation model.
